sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are in outstanding form with a win in their most recent outing and seven wins from their last ten games, currently sat top of the table with 22 points. Alsager Town arrive in poor shape—bottom of the division with just four points from ten games and five losses in their last six outings, making this a significant mismatch.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face Dawley Town at home in a match with title-race implications; Stafford have 20 points and will be looking to close the two-point gap on Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, who sit third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in an all-top-six clash; Eccleshall are sixth with 18 points but arrive on the back of a loss. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community in a potential trap game against a mid-table side. Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points) host Foley Meir, while Barnton (seventh, 15 points) visit Shawbury United (15th, 10 points). Elsewhere, Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town—the latter remain pointless in 20th place—and Market Drayton Town, 10th with 12 points, travel to face New Mills (eighth, 14 points). Crewe host Allscott Heath in a basement-area fixture, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in another battle among the lower reaches of the table.
